diagnosis.root_cause: The physical R84 R30 fixed-function XYZRHW path provided finite recentered headset/world plane only to exact StageExtensionTime. The same screen-HUD GOAL 0-99% progress, finish-time helpers and verified stage-result printf paths survived D3DX GPU batching but fell into generic 2D FOV-only placement. Unlike the shader HUD, that path did not reproject game clip coordinates through the latched head/world plane, causing optical disparity/duplicate risk.
